subject: Post-demo security intake: request for SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access
messages:
From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@pioneerwell.com>, Elena Varela <elena.v@pioneerwell.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-demo security intake: request for SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access

Hi Samir / Elena —

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap from our side and a short list of next steps so procurement/security can kickoff: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent period) — can you share the PDF or a link to the report? If there are NDAs required before we can access the full report, let us know.

2) Bridge letter / temporary attestation — does PioneerWell have a bridge letter we can reference while the Type II report is being processed? A scanned signed .pdf is fine.

3) Trust portal access — we typically use our evidence portal (or can accept S3/Drive links). If you can provision a read-only folder or invite security@redwood.ai, that will speed things up.

4) Vendor security questionnaire (we'll start the short DDQ). I attached a short vendor questionnaire template (lightweight) to speed triage — if you prefer to send your VSQ instead, we'll ingest it.

High level ask: can you share the Type II report or temporary attestation and either (a) invite security@redwood.ai to your portal, or (b) upload artifacts to a temporary secure link by next Friday (2026-11-26)?

I cc'd Marissa and Ben to help coordinate procurement/pricing and loop in our security reviewer. David (cc) — would you be able to do a quick review once the materials arrive?

Thanks — appreciate it.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0199

Subject: Re: Post-demo security intake: request for SOC 2 Type II report, bridge letter, and trust portal access

Hi Karthik —

Great to meet today — thanks for the concise next steps. A couple quick notes: 

- I've attached our VSQ responses (initial pass) and our procurement contact Elena is on copy to coordinate contract-level items.
- We host artifacts in our internal assurance portal; we typically provide temporary share links after an NDA is in place.
- We do have a current SOC 2 Type II report from the period ending 2026-06-30. Because that report contains proprietary controls detail, we can provide a redacted PDF or grant portal access.

Questions for you: is a redacted PDF sufficient for your security review or do you need full portal access? Also, do you require a signed bridge letter (we can provide one) or will an emailed temporary attestation suffice for initial procurement?

Proposed timeline: we'll get the VSQ file posted by end of day today, and can share either a redacted Type II PDF or initiate the portal invite after a brief NDA — happy to move on whichever path you prefer.

Thanks,
Samir Khan
Security & Compliance Lead
PioneerWell Health
samir.khan@pioneerwell.com

Looping in David to triage security intake.

David — Samir just shared an initial VSQ and says they can either provide (A) a redacted Type II PDF or (B) grant us portal access after a quick NDA. For procurement timelines we should aim to have something actionable this week to avoid slowing the deal.

My proposed approach: ask for a redacted Type II PDF + scanned bridge letter first (fast), and request portal access if we need deeper artifacts. Karthik / Ben — if that works, I'll let Elena know our preference so they can post the files.

Action items: 
- David: please confirm whether a redacted PDF + bridge letter will let you complete the first-pass security review, or whether you need portal-level artifacts.
- Marissa: I'll draft a short NDA template for portal access if needed (30-min turnaround).

Thanks — Marissa

Hi Samir / Elena —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Redacted PDF + bridge letter will be perfect for our initial review and procurement queue. If we need portal artifacts after that, we'll request access through the NDA flow Marissa mentioned.

To make this easy we can: 
- You can upload the redacted PDF and the signed bridge letter to a secure folder or send links to the files.
- Alternately, if you prefer us to pull from your trust portal, you can invite security@redwood.ai to a read-only view (we'll accept a time-limited link).

As promised, I'm also attaching a draft bridge letter template we can use if it helps speed signature. Once we receive the files I'll have David review and provide a short summary for the procurement team.

Next steps & timeline: 
- Samir/Elena: upload redacted Type II + bridge letter by EOD Monday (2026-11-22) or send portal invite.
- David: quick security review will target 48 business hours after we receive artifacts.
- Marissa / Ben: procurement prep and any contract redlines follow after signoff.

Thank you — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Karthik
